name: LurkAPI
summary: Social-media data API and remote MCP server: public posts, profiles, comments, transcripts and ad-library results from 16 platforms as JSON.
description: REST base https://api.lurkapi.com with OpenAPI 3.1 (about 89 paths) and llms.txt. Auth is an x-api-key (or Bearer) lk_live_… key; MCP clients can also complete OAuth in the browser. Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP at https://api.lurkapi.com/mcp exposes one tool per endpoint, or https://api.lurkapi.com/mcp?compact with find_endpoints and call_endpoint for clients that load every tool up front. Platforms include Facebook, Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, Google, Bluesky, Snapchat, Truth Social, Telegram, X, Threads, Instagram, LinkedIn, link-in-bio, eBay and Web. Endpoints cost 1–31 credits per call (from $0.45 per 1,000 credits); new accounts get 100 free credits with no card. Rate limit 50 requests per 10 seconds per account. Read-only public data.

agent_access.notes: x-api-key / Bearer lk_live_…, or MCP OAuth. Compact mode: /mcp?compact.
